hypothesis: E5-small-v2 with its required asymmetric prefixes and labeled catalog fields improves target Recall@200 and adds unique BM25 rescues beyond the generic MiniLM control without violating offline packaging budgets.

candidate.offline_evaluation_command: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 uv run python -m scripts.run_dense_retrieval

all_required: candidate first-turn dense Recall@200 >= MiniLM first-turn dense Recall@200 + 0.03
candidate first-turn BM25+dense union Recall@200 >= MiniLM first-turn union Recall@200 + 0.01
candidate has at least 5 first-turn dense-only BM25 rescues
candidate warm p95 <= 500 ms, peak process memory <= 4096 MB, and model assets <= 500 MB
recall_gate.action_if_pass: Run frozen-fold complete-policy dense, sparse-head union, RRF, calibrated weighted fusion, and conditional fusion/reranking variants.
recall_gate.action_if_fail: Park standalone and preserve retrieval diagnostics; do not run end-to-end model selection.

promotion_rule: Promote only if the retrieval gate passes and a downstream frozen-fold variant turns the added recall into stable Top-10 technical-score improvement with acceptable resources.
